description:
## Goal
One script, `atm-task-close.py --role <dev|fix|sanity|qa> --vars <file>`, is the only way a dev, fix, sanity or qa task completes (task-close-hook.md 1). The agent never runs `bd close` or `atm task close ... completed` by hand for those roles. The script checks the minimum, closes the bead, reports to the lead and assigns the next bead as the phase lead. Governing text: `docs/requirements/task-close-hook.md` items 1 to 19, `dev.md` 2, 4, 15, 17, 20, 24, `dev-sanity.md` 11, 13, 28, 29, 32, 47, `quality-mgr.md` 20, `team-lead.md` 14, 15, 21, 23, 24, 28. Anchors: ANC-051, 052, 053, 054, 055, 056, 057, 058, 059, 060, 070, 071, 072.

## Deliverables
1. `scripts/atm-task-close.py`: one `--role` argument, mandatory, one of `dev`, `fix`, `sanity`, `qa`; `--vars <file>`; `--skip-checks` described only in `--help` as "skips the PR and stack checks. Do NOT use without permission from the phase lead." and named in no template or prompt (ANC-059). Result is JSON on stdout, `{"ok": {...}}` or `{"err": {"code", "message", "fix"}}`, exit code mirroring it; every `err` names the exact fix (task-close-hook.md 3). No ledger of its own.
2. Input validation (ANC-058): the vars file is the sc-compose `--vars` payload the role's templates already take; the script validates it by rendering `templates/task-close-vars.j2`, a header-only strict template whose `required_variables` name every field the role needs, through `sc_render.render` before any check runs; `commit`, `pr_number` and `branch` must be non-empty for the dev and fix roles; the same file is passed unchanged to every `atm task assign` and `atm send --template` the script runs.
3. Identity (ANC-051): `atm task assign` and the close of the dev's task run with `ATM_IDENTITY=<lead>` and `ATM_TEAM=<team>` set on that one subprocess only, `lead` read from `.atm-bd/phase-<x>.toml` and the team from `.atm.toml`; every other `bd` and `atm` write runs as the caller with `--actor "$ATM_IDENTITY"`. The script never changes its own environment.
4. Role `dev` and `fix` (ANC-054, task-close-hook.md 7 to 12): checks, in order: the vars; the worktree is clean and HEAD equals the pushed head on `origin/<branch>`; the current top (the last entry of the stack bead's `metadata.layers`, else `pr_target`) is an ancestor of HEAD, read with local git and no GitHub call; an open PR exists for `branch` with HEAD as its head, through one `gh api` call, only when GitHub is reachable. Nothing else: not the whole stack, not lint or tests. On pass: `bd update <bead> --set-metadata commit=<sha> pr_number=<n> pr_url=<url>`; `bd close <bead> --reason "dev complete at <sha>"` (`fixed at <sha>` for a fix); the dev-complete or fix-complete report to the lead by plain `atm send --template` (not a task close); `atm task assign <dev-sanity member> --task-id <sanity bead> --template dev-sanity-template.xml.j2 --vars <same file>` as the lead. The dev's ATM task stays open (ANC-055). The sanity bead is `metadata.sanity_bead` of the checked bead when present, else the open `stage:dev-sanity` bead whose `metadata.dev_bead` is the checked bead; none: `err` naming the lead. Fix outcome `not_reproducible`: the PR and head checks are skipped, `bd close --reason "not reproducible: <file:line>"`, the same report and the same sanity assignment.
5. GitHub unreachable or rate limited (ANC-059): not a failure; the PR check falls back to the local checks of deliverable 4, the result records `github: unavailable`, and sanity is assigned. Retry a failed GitHub call three times before falling back.
6. Role `sanity` (task-close-hook.md 13 to 17): input the verdict (`PASS`, `FAIL`, `CANNOT_RUN`), the sha, the selected undone deliverables with their reasons, the checked bead and its assignee, the group's QA bead, and for PASS the stack result from the link (`stacked`, new top, `stack_number`). A PASS close without a stack result is refused with `err` code `SANITY.NOT_STACKED` naming the link as the fix (sanity-stack.md 13). PASS: `bd close <sanity bead> --reason "PASS at <sha>"`; `atm task close <checked bead> completed` as the lead; `atm task close <sanity bead> completed --template dev-sanity-complete.md.j2`; `atm task assign <qa member> --task-id <qa bead> --template qa-template.xml.j2 --vars <file>` as the lead, with `base` the PR base, `commit`, `round`, and for a fix bead `carry_forward` (ANC-053). FAIL below the cap: `bd update <sanity bead> --set-metadata sanity_round=<n+1>`; `bd update <checked bead> --status open --assignee <its assignee>`; `atm send <assignee> --template sanity-fail.xml.j2 --vars <file>` on the dev's open task; `atm task close <sanity bead> completed --template dev-sanity-complete.md.j2` with verdict FAIL; no finding bead, no child bead, no new task, no new layer (ANC-056, ANC-072). FAIL at the cap: `max_sanity_rounds` from the repository configuration (default 5 when unset); the script reopens nothing, sends the lead `SANITY.ROUND_CAP` with the undone deliverable numbers and closes the sanity task with verdict FAIL; the dev's task stays open (ANC-057). CANNOT_RUN: bead open, no assignee, task `refused` (dev-sanity 31). A `rebase-required` outcome is not a close: the script exposes no path for it that touches `sanity_round` (ANC-071).
7. Role `qa` (ANC-070, quality-mgr 20): input the verdict, the sha, the round; `bd close <qa bead>` first, then `atm task close <qa bead> completed --template qa-complete.md.j2` only if the bead close succeeded; one plain `atm send` status message to the phase lead, PASS and FAIL alike; assigns nothing.
8. `templates/task-close-vars.j2`: header-only strict template, `required_variables` per role through `defaults` and the role switch in deliverable 2; `templates/sanity-fail.xml.j2`: the sprint and checked bead ids and title, branch, PR and sha checked, round n of `max_sanity_rounds`, and one numbered line per deliverable that was NOT complete with the selected reviewer's reason verbatim, nothing else (ANC-072); `templates/rebase-required.xml.j2`: the checked bead, the branch, the recorded top it must rebase onto and the instruction to push and run the hook again (ANC-065). Example vars under `examples/task-close-vars-<role>.json`.
9. `max_sanity_rounds` in the repository configuration: `config/atm-bd-orchestration.yaml.j2` gains the key with default 5; `install.py` renders it from the consumer registry key `max_sanity_rounds` when present, else 5; `repo_config.py` exposes it (ANC-057).
10. Template close steps: `dev-template.xml.j2`, `fix-assignment.xml.j2`, `dev-sanity-template.xml.j2` and `qa-template.xml.j2` end with "run `atm-task-close.py --role <role> --vars <file>`; on `err` fix the named cause and run it again"; the dev and fix templates say the task stays open until sanity PASS, that a `task_reminder` during the wait is answered by waiting, and that a `sanity-fail` or `rebase-required` message means rebase onto the current top, push and run the hook again (dev 2, 17, 20). No template names `--skip-checks`.
11. `scripts/sanity-create-findings` deleted with its tests; `sanity-merge`, `sanity-split` and `sanity-run-history` unchanged (dev-sanity 47).
12. Tests, `scripts/tests/test_task_close.py`, with injected runners (no live bd, atm, gh or GitHub): each role's command sequence and identity per command; the vars validation failing before any git or gh call; `--skip-checks` absent from every template and agent file; `github: unavailable` fallback; the FAIL counter and the cap; the PASS refusal without a stack result; the qa role assigning nothing.

## Required Work
- Read `docs/requirements/task-close-hook.md` and `docs/diagrams/lifecycle.md` before coding; the command sequences there are the specification.
- `sc_render.render` for every template render, strict; never pipe a render into `jq`.
- Every subprocess is a fixed argv, never a shell string.

## This Sprint Does Not Close
- The stack bead's schema, pour and `validate-plan` check (bj-2); the script reads `metadata.layers` of `<prefix>-phase-<x>.stack` when the bead exists and falls back to `pr_target` when it does not.
- The link on PASS, the sanity-stack subagent and the dev-sanity prompt (bj-3); this sprint's sanity role only requires the stack result in its vars.
- The console runs tabs and the ledger producers (bj-4).
- The atm-core task-transition hook (ANC-064, atm-core #1873): not in this phase.
design:
## Public Contract
```
atm-task-close.py --role dev|fix|sanity|qa --vars <file> [--skip-checks]
stdout: {"ok": {"role": ..., "bead": ..., "commit": ..., "pr_number": ..., "github": "ok"|"unavailable", "assigned": [<task ids>], "closed": [<bead ids>]}}
      | {"err": {"code": "VARS.MISSING"|"VARS.EMPTY"|"HEAD.NOT_PUSHED"|"TOP.NOT_ANCESTOR"|"PR.NOT_FOUND"|"SANITY.NOT_STACKED"|"SANITY.ROUND_CAP"|"BEAD.NO_SANITY", "message": ..., "fix": ...}}
exit 0 on ok, 1 on err
```
Identity per command (task-close-hook.md 4):
```python
LEAD_ENV = {**os.environ, "ATM_IDENTITY": lead, "ATM_TEAM": team}   # atm task assign; atm task close <checked bead>
run(["atm", "task", "assign", member, "--task-id", bead, "--template", tpl, "--vars", vars_path], env=LEAD_ENV)
run(["bd", "close", bead, "--reason", reason, "--actor", os.environ["ATM_IDENTITY"]])        # caller
```
`task-close-vars.j2` header:
```
---
name: task-close-vars
format: text
required_variables: [role, task_id, sprint, phase, checked_bead, branch, worktree_path, commit, pr_number, pr_url, pr_target]
defaults: {verdict: "", outcome: "", undone: [], stacked: {}, round: 0, carry_forward: "", qa_bead: "", sanity_bead: ""}
---
```
Current top: `bd show <prefix>-phase-<x>.stack --json` → `metadata.layers[-1].branch`, else `pr_target`; `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/<top> HEAD`.

## Exact Targets
- new `scripts/atm-task-close.py`, `scripts/tests/test_task_close.py`, `templates/task-close-vars.j2`, `templates/sanity-fail.xml.j2`, `templates/rebase-required.xml.j2`, `examples/task-close-vars-{dev,fix,sanity,qa}.json`
- edited `templates/dev-template.xml.j2`, `fix-assignment.xml.j2`, `dev-sanity-template.xml.j2`, `qa-template.xml.j2` (close steps), `config/atm-bd-orchestration.yaml.j2`, `install.py`, `skills/atm-beads/scripts/repo_config.py`, `scripts/tests/test_templates.py`
- deleted `scripts/sanity-create-findings` and its tests
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] (ANC-054) `atm-task-close.py --help` lists `--role` as mandatory with the four values; the dev-role check list in the source is exactly: vars, clean worktree and pushed head, top is ancestor, open PR with HEAD as head; `rg -n "just lint|just test|cargo" scripts/atm-task-close.py` returns nothing.
- [ ] (ANC-058) a vars file missing `commit` fails with `VARS.MISSING` before any git or gh call (test with injected runners asserting zero calls).
- [ ] (ANC-051) in the test's recorded calls, every `atm task assign` and the close of the checked bead's task carry `ATM_IDENTITY=<lead from .atm-bd/phase-x.toml>`; every `bd` write carries `--actor <caller>`.
- [ ] (ANC-052, ANC-055) a dev-role run in a scratch repository with fixture bd and atm: the bead is closed, the sanity task is assigned with the same vars file, and no `atm task close <dev task> completed` was issued.
- [ ] (ANC-053) a sanity-role PASS run assigns the qa bead to the qa member as the lead and closes the checked bead's task as the lead.
- [ ] (ANC-056, ANC-072) a sanity-role FAIL run issues exactly one `atm send <assignee> --template sanity-fail.xml.j2`, reopens the checked bead to its assignee, creates no bead, and the rendered message lists exactly the undone deliverables with their reasons and the sprint id.
- [ ] (ANC-057) five FAIL runs with no `max_sanity_rounds` setting leave `sanity_round` at 4 and the fifth sends `SANITY.ROUND_CAP` to the lead and reopens nothing; with `max_sanity_rounds: 2` the second does.
- [ ] (ANC-059) with the GitHub runner raising, a dev-role run exits ok with `"github": "unavailable"` after three attempts; `rg -n "skip-checks" templates agents docs/requirements` matches only the script's own `--help` text.
- [ ] (ANC-070) a qa-role run with verdict FAIL closes the qa bead then the task, sends the lead one status message and issues no `atm task assign`.
- [ ] (ANC-071) `rg -n sanity_round scripts/atm-task-close.py` shows the only increment on the FAIL branch.
- [ ] (dev-sanity 47) `scripts/sanity-create-findings` does not exist and nothing references it: `rg -n sanity-create-findings plugins apps` returns nothing.
- [ ] the four assignment templates render strictly with their example vars and name the hook as the close step; `rg -n "atm task close .* completed" templates/dev-template.xml.j2 templates/fix-assignment.xml.j2` returns nothing.

## Validation
- `just lint` and `just test` in the atm-bd-orchestration worktree.
- `python3 -m pytest plugins/atm-bd-orchestration/skills/atm-bd-orchestration/scripts/tests/test_task_close.py -q`
